question: Good morning, I am locked out, please help. I already restarted twice.
reference_answer: Clarified the request with the user by phone. User completed the self-service reset with Authenticator verification. Confirmed sign-in to laptop and Outlook. Followed KB-1001.

KB-1001: Open https://id.larkhaven.example/reset in any browser, on any network.
Enter your work email address and choose Verify with LarkID Authenticator.
Approve the prompt on your phone and type the two-digit number shown on the screen.
Choose a new password of at least 14 characters that is not one of your last 10 passwords.
Lock and unlock your laptop with the new password so the saved sign-in is updated.
Update the password in the mail app on your phone if it asks for it.

question:
Hi there,

VPN says connected but none of the internal sites open. Google works. This is the second time this month. My whole team has the same problem.
reference_answer: Browser secure DNS was bypassing the VPN resolver. Disabled it and internal sites resolved. Followed KB-1020.

KB-1020: Open Terminal and run: sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder
Open System Settings, Network, your connection, Details, DNS, and remove any servers you added by hand.
In the browser settings turn off Use secure DNS.

question: i keep getting 'your account is locked. lid-1203' when i sign in on my windows 11 laptop. device: dell latitude 5440. no rush, whenever you have time. regards, anika
reference_answer: Cleared stale saved credentials on the laptop and removed the old mail profile on the tablet. No further lockouts after 30 minutes. Followed KB-1002.

KB-1002: Wait 30 minutes for the automatic unlock, or unlock now at https://id.larkhaven.example/unlock using LarkID Authenticator.
Before signing in again, update or remove the old password on every phone, tablet and mail app.
On Windows, open Credential Manager and delete saved entries for larkhaven.example.
On macOS, open Keychain Access and delete saved larkhaven.example passwords.
Sign in once with the current password and check that the lock does not return within 15 minutes.

question: Teams says no microphone found since I got the new dock. I am using a Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4.
reference_answer: Teams was using the dock audio device. Selected the headset in Devices; test call passed. Followed KB-1043.

KB-1043: In Teams open Settings, Devices, and choose the right speaker, microphone and camera; make a test call.
Open Windows Settings, Privacy and security, Camera, and turn on Let desktop apps access your camera. Do the same for Microphone.
Close other apps that use the camera, such as Zoom or the Camera app.
Unplug and reconnect a USB headset or dock.
Slide open the privacy shutter above the screen if the picture is black.

question: every code from the authenticator app is rejected with lid-mfa-102. i am travelling this week. this has been happening since monday. device: dell latitude 7450. restarting did not help.
reference_answer: Duplicate account entry in the app. Removed the stale entry and tested a push approval successfully. Followed KB-1006.

KB-1006: On the phone, set date and time to automatic and confirm the time zone is correct.
Close and reopen LarkID Authenticator, then try a new code.
If there are two Larkhaven entries in the app, delete the older one.
Use a push approval instead of typing a code if the option is offered.
If codes are still rejected, raise a ticket; the Identity and Access team will reset your registration after verifying your identity.

question: hi, i cannot call external nubmers from teams, there is no dial pad. please help
reference_answer: No calling licence assigned. Telephony request approved by the manager; number assigned and dial pad visible.

KB-1099: Open Teams and choose Calls; if there is no dial pad, you have no phone number yet.
Request a number in HelpHub under Request telephony; your manager approves.
Set voicemail and call forwarding under Settings, Calls.
Use a certified headset; laptop speakers cause echo for the other side.
Emergency calls from Teams report the address of your registered office, not your home.

question: How do I get access to the project tracker? I cannot find where to request it. I am using a Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 4. Regards, Pedro
reference_answer: Explained that approval must be given in HelpHub, not by email. User submitted the request; manager approved and access was granted. Followed KB-1009.

KB-1009: Open https://helphub.larkhaven.example and choose Request access.
Search for the application and pick the role you need; choose the lowest role that lets you do your job.
Write the business reason in one or two sentences. Requests without a reason are returned.
Submit. Your line manager is asked to approve; restricted applications are then sent to the data owner.
When approved, access is granted automatically within 60 minutes and the tile appears in the LarkID portal.

question: outlook shows 0x800ccc0e when i send and receive. webmail works. i already restarted twice. many thanks
reference_answer: Work Offline was enabled. Turned it off and mail flowed. Followed KB-1036.

KB-1036: Open https://outlook.larkhaven.example in a browser. If webmail works, the mailbox is healthy.
In Outlook open the Send / Receive tab and make sure Work Offline is not highlighted.
Close Outlook, hold Ctrl while starting it, and choose Yes to start in safe mode. If it connects, disable add-ins one at a time.
Open Control Panel, Mail, Show Profiles, add a new profile and set it as default.
Start Outlook and let the mailbox synchronise; a large mailbox can take an hour.

question: I sent a document to print and nothing comes out when I badge in. It began yesterday afternoon.
reference_answer: Badge was not linked to the user. Linked it at the printer with LarkID sign-in.

KB-1064: Open App Hub and run Add office printers; the queue FollowMe-EMEA is installed.
Print to FollowMe-EMEA from any application.
At any printer, tap your badge on the reader and choose Print all or select jobs.
Jobs not released within 24 hours are deleted.
To scan, tap your badge, choose Scan to my email, and the scan arrives as a PDF.
For paper jams or toner, use the QR code on the printer; for anything else raise a ticket. Support hours are 07:00 to 19:00 UK time, Monday to Friday.

question: I installed the VPN but it asks to allow a system extension and I do not know where.
reference_answer: System extension had not been allowed. Approved it in Privacy and Security; VPN connected.

KB-1017: Open App Hub from Launchpad and install SecureTunnel.
When macOS asks, open System Settings, Privacy and Security, and allow the SecureTunnel system extension.
Allow SecureTunnel to add VPN configurations when prompted.
Click the SecureTunnel icon in the menu bar, choose Connect and sign in with LarkID.
Approve the prompt in LarkID Authenticator; the menu bar icon shows a closed lock when connected.
Open https://intranet.larkhaven.example to confirm internal sites load.

question: Typing lags and Excel hangs on my Windows 11 laptop. A colleague tried to help but could not fix it.
reference_answer: 8 GB laptop older than four years with memory above 90 percent under normal load. Raised a replacement request under the device policy. Followed KB-1054.

KB-1054: Restart the laptop; choose Restart, not Shut down, so updates finish installing.
Open Settings, Windows Update, install everything offered and restart again.
Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to open Task Manager and sort Processes by Memory and by CPU. Close what you do not need.
In Task Manager open Startup apps and disable those you do not use daily.
Open Settings, System, Storage, and free space until at least 15 percent of the disk is free.
If Task Manager shows memory above 85 percent with only your normal apps open, raise a ticket; include the laptop asset tag.

question: Installer says access is denied. I downloaded it from the vendor site. It is not urgent but it is annoying.
reference_answer: Old version was still running in the tray. Closed it, reset the App Hub cache and reinstalled. Followed KB-1078.

KB-1078: Do not look for an administrator password; install the application from App Hub instead.
If the App Hub installation fails with the same code, close every window of the application and its tray icon.
Restart the laptop to clear pending updates.
In App Hub open Settings and choose Reset cache, then Install again.
If it still fails, raise a ticket for Software Packaging with the application name and the time of the attempt.

question:
Hello IT,

Joined the finance team this week and need FinSight analyst access.

Thanks
reference_answer: No free FinSight licence. Reclaimed one unused for more than 60 days, then granted Viewer access after both approvals. Followed KB-1010.

KB-1010: In HelpHub choose Request access and search for FinSight.
Pick a role: Viewer for reports, Analyst to build reports, Admin for the Finance systems team only.
State which cost centres or legal entities you need to see and why.
After your manager approves, the request goes to the Finance data owner, who answers within 2 business days.
If no licence is free, the request waits until one is reclaimed; licences unused for 60 days are reclaimed automatically.
On first sign-in open FinSight from the LarkID portal and accept the confidentiality notice.

question:
Hello IT,

New hire starts next week and I cannot find them in the new joiner form. I already restarted twice
reference_answer: Request received 2 business days before start. Issued a loan laptop for week one; standard laptop followed. Followed KB-1091.

KB-1091: Confirm with HR that the joiner's PeopleHub record exists and shows the correct start date; IT cannot create an account without it.
In HelpHub choose New joiner and select the person from the PeopleHub list.
Choose the laptop: Standard, or Developer with a business reason.
Choose the role profile for the team; it sets the usual applications and access groups.
Add anything beyond the profile as separate access requests; restricted applications still need the data owner.
Say where the laptop goes: a Tech Bar for collection or a home address.
Two business days before the start date you receive the temporary access pass to hand over on day one.

question: Back from six weeks of leave and my laptop no longer connects to the office Wi-Fi. This has been happening since Monday.
reference_answer: Certificate had expired while the laptop was offline. Repaired it from App Hub over cable and forgot the saved network; reconnected.

KB-1027: Connect by cable, or join the guest network and start SecureTunnel.
Open App Hub and run Repair network certificate.
Open Settings, Network and internet, Wi-Fi, Manage known networks, and forget LarkNet.

question:
Hi team,

Outlook asks for my password every five minutes on my Windows 11 laptop. I type it and it asks again.
reference_answer: Removed stale saved credentials and signed in again with LarkID. No further prompts. Followed KB-1037.

KB-1037: Open Credential Manager, Windows Credentials, and remove entries that start with MicrosoftOffice or contain larkhaven.example.
Start Outlook and sign in once with LarkID, approving the prompt on your phone.
If the prompt returns, open File, Office Account, Sign out, then sign in again.

question: Is there someone I can see in person about my laptop? Laptop asset tag LH-L-00272. I cannot do any work until this is sorted.
reference_answer: Walk-up help is at the Tech Bar: Chicago, floor 3, 09:00 to 16:00; Toronto, floor 2, 10:00 to 15:00.

KB-1095: Walk-up help is at the Tech Bar: Chicago, floor 3, 09:00 to 16:00; Toronto, floor 2, 10:00 to 15:00.

question:
hi,

only one external display works on my mac. this is the second time this month.

thanks, tariq
reference_answer: MacBook Air supports one external screen on a standard dock. Supplied a DisplayLink dock. Followed KB-1059.

KB-1059: Connect the dock to power and the screens to the dock.
Connect the dock's USB-C cable to any port on the Mac.
Open System Settings, Displays, choose Arrange and drag the screens into the order they sit on your desk.
MacBook Air models drive one external screen through a standard dock; a second screen needs a DisplayLink dock from IT.
If a screen stays black, unplug the dock from power for 10 seconds and reconnect.

question: VPN gives authentication failed ST-401 right after I approve on my phone. Restarting did not help
reference_answer: Contractor account was missing from the remote access group. Access request approved by the manager; VPN sign-in works. Followed KB-1024.

KB-1024: Sign in at https://id.larkhaven.example to confirm your password works and the account is not locked.
In SecureTunnel choose Settings, Forget saved sign-in, then connect and type the password again.
Contractors and new joiners: check with your manager that remote access was requested for you.
If the portal sign-in works but the VPN still shows ST-401, raise a ticket for Network Operations.

question: OneDrive has been stuck on processing changes for two days on my Windows 11 laptop. It began yesterday afternoon.
reference_answer: A folder contained file names with colons. Renamed them and sync completed. Followed KB-1046.

KB-1046: Select the OneDrive cloud icon and read the message it shows.
For error 0x8004de40, check the internet connection, then sign out of OneDrive from Settings, Account, and sign in again.
Rename files the sync client lists as not allowed.
Free up disk space until at least 1 GB is available.
Press Windows key + R and run: %localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset
Start OneDrive again from the Start menu and allow up to an hour for a full re-check.

question: Nboody can hear me in Teams meetings on my macOS laptop. The headset works for music. It worked fine last week.
reference_answer: Camera permission was off in privacy settings. Enabled it and restarted Teams. Followed KB-1044.

KB-1044: In Teams open Settings, Devices, and choose the right speaker, microphone and camera; make a test call.
Open System Settings, Privacy and Security, Camera, and turn on Microsoft Teams. Do the same for Microphone.
Quit and reopen Teams; macOS applies the permission only after a restart of the app.
Close other apps that use the camera.

question: My visitor joined the guest network but never gets past the sign-in page.
reference_answer: Issued a three-day guest pass through HelpHub for the workshop attendees. Followed KB-1029.

KB-1029: Ask the visitor to join the network LarkGuest-AMER and open any web page.
On the sign-in page the visitor enters their name and your work email address as sponsor.
You receive an email; choose Approve. Access lasts until midnight local time.
For visits longer than one day, request a multi-day guest pass in HelpHub at least one business day ahead.
Guest Wi-Fi gives internet access only. Visitors cannot reach printers or internal systems.

question: VPN fails with error 809 on my Windows laptop. It worked in the office yesterday.
reference_answer: Home router was blocking UDP 500 and 4500. Enabled TLS fallback in SecureTunnel settings; connected on TCP 443.

KB-1018: Connect the laptop to a phone hotspot and try the VPN. If it works, the first network is blocking it.
Restart the home router, then try again.
In the router settings turn on IPsec passthrough, sometimes called VPN passthrough.
In SecureTunnel open Settings, Protocol, and choose TLS fallback, which uses TCP port 443.
Restart the laptop and connect again.
If error 809 appears on every network, raise a ticket for Network Operations and attach the SecureTunnel log bundle.

question: Hi, Outlook on my phone says the device must be managed. Thanks, Nikhil
reference_answer: Confirm the phone platform. Enrol it in DeviceCare, install the applicable managed Outlook app, and sign in with LarkID.

KB-1034: Install DeviceCare from the App Store and sign in with LarkID to enrol the phone.
Accept the management profile in Settings, General, VPN and Device Management.
Install Outlook from the App Store.
Open Outlook, add your work address and sign in with LarkID.
Set a 6-digit passcode if the phone asks; shorter passcodes are not accepted.
KB-1035: Install DeviceCare from Google Play and sign in with LarkID to create the work profile.
Open the work profile's Play Store, marked with a briefcase, and install Outlook.
Open the work copy of Outlook, add your work address and sign in with LarkID.
Set a 6-digit screen lock if the phone asks; patterns are not accepted.

question: My second monitor is not detected through the dock on my Dell Latitude 7440. I have not tried anything yet.
reference_answer: Power-cycled the dock; displays returned. Followed KB-1058.

KB-1058: Connect the dock to power and both screens to the dock.
Connect the dock's USB-C cable to the laptop port marked with a lightning or D symbol.
Press Windows key + P and choose Extend.
Open Settings, System, Display, drag the screens into the order they sit on your desk and choose the main display.
If a screen stays black, open App Hub and run Driver updates, then restart with the dock connected.

question:
Hello IT,

My laptop blue screens two or three times a day with DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL. My laptop is a Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 (Windows 11). I already restarted twice.

Thanks, Valentina
reference_answer: Memory diagnostics failed. Laptop replaced under warranty.

KB-1069: Write down or photograph the stop code before the laptop restarts.
After the restart, open Settings, Windows Update and install everything offered.
Open App Hub and run Driver updates.
Disconnect the dock for a day to see whether the crashes stop.
If it happens again within a week, raise a ticket with the stop code, the time and what you were doing.

question: since i changed my password my mac asks for the login keychain password every few minutes. it began yesterday afternoon. restarting did not help.
reference_answer: Old password no longer known. Reset the default keychain, restarted and re-signed in to Outlook and Teams. Prompts stopped. Followed KB-1014.

KB-1014: When prompted, try your previous password once; if it works, choose Update Keychain Password.
If you do not remember the old password, open Keychain Access, choose Settings and Reset Default Keychains.
Restart the Mac and sign in with your current LarkID password.
Sign in to Outlook, Teams and OneDrive again when they ask.

question: Hello IT, I replaced my phone at the weekend and the old one is already wiped. I cannot approve any sign-in. Many thanks
reference_answer: User still had the old phone. Guided adding the new device at id.larkhaven.example/security and removing the old one. Followed KB-1007.

KB-1007: If you still have the old phone, sign in at https://id.larkhaven.example/security and approve with the old phone.
Choose Add method, register the app on the new phone, then remove the old phone from the list.
If the old phone is lost, broken or wiped, raise a HelpHub ticket in the category MFA reset.
The Identity and Access team will verify you by video call with your manager present or with your badge at a Tech Bar.
After verification you receive a temporary access pass valid for 60 minutes to register the new phone.

question:
Hello,

I overwrote a spreadsheet in OneDrive and need yesterday's version.
reference_answer: Recovered the messages from Recover items recently removed. Within the 30-day window. Followed KB-1041.

KB-1041: Email: open Deleted Items and move the message back to your inbox.
If it is not there, choose Recover items recently removed from this folder at the top of Deleted Items.
Files: open OneDrive in a browser, choose Recycle bin, select the file and choose Restore.
For an earlier version of a file, right-click it in OneDrive and choose Version history.
After these periods the item cannot be recovered by IT either.

question: My visitor joined the guest network but never gets past the sign-in page. I have not tried anything yet.
reference_answer: Issued a three-day guest pass through HelpHub for the workshop attendees. Followed KB-1031.

KB-1031: Ask the visitor to join the network LarkGuest-APAC and open any web page.
On the sign-in page the visitor enters their name and your work email address as sponsor.
You receive an email; choose Approve. Access lasts until midnight local time.
For visits longer than one day, request a multi-day guest pass in HelpHub at least one business day ahead.
Guest Wi-Fi gives internet access only. Visitors cannot reach printers or internal systems.

question: What is the approved way to share big files with a customer?
reference_answer: Introduced SendSafe for external transfer. File sent with a 7-day expiry. Followed KB-1053.

KB-1053: For colleagues, upload the file to OneDrive, choose Share and send the link.
For external recipients, open https://sendsafe.larkhaven.example and sign in with LarkID.
Upload up to 20 GB, enter the recipient's email address and set an expiry of at most 14 days.
The recipient gets a link and a one-time code by separate emails.
Files classified Restricted must not be sent through SendSafe without the data owner's written approval.

question: Hello, The org chart shows my old manager.
reference_answer: Sign-in issue confirmed. Cleared the browser session and PeopleHub opened.

KB-1100: If PeopleHub does not open or rejects your sign-in, check that other LarkID applications work, then raise an IT ticket.
For payslips, leave balances, job titles, managers or personal details, contact HR through the Ask HR tile in the LarkID portal.
IT cannot see or change PeopleHub records.
A wrong manager or job title elsewhere, such as in your email signature, is corrected by HR in PeopleHub and follows within 24 hours.

question: Hello, The tile for the expense tool has gone from my portal. It was there last week. It started after the latest update.
reference_answer: Access was removed in the quarterly review because the app had not been used for 90 days. User raised a new access request.

KB-1008: Open https://id.larkhaven.example and choose Refresh my apps from the profile menu.
Sign out of the portal and sign in again.
Check HelpHub, My requests, to see whether an access request is still waiting for approval.
If you have never requested the application, follow the article Request access to an application.

question: I started today and my temporary pass does not work on the laptop. I have not tried anything yet. Please help.
reference_answer: Applications had not been requested in the new joiner form. Manager raised access requests.

KB-1090: Collect your laptop from the Tech Bar or open the delivery box; your manager has your temporary access pass.
Switch on, connect to Wi-Fi and sign in with your work email address and the temporary access pass.
Set your LarkID password: at least 14 characters.
Install LarkID Authenticator on your phone and register it when prompted.
Open App Hub and install the applications listed under Recommended for your team.
Open the LarkID portal to check that the applications your manager requested are there.
Anything missing: ask your manager first, because access requests need their approval.

question: Hi team, I need a PDF editor installed on my Windows 11 laptop and I do not have admin rights. Regards, Jin
reference_answer: Application is available in App Hub. User installed it without admin rights.

KB-1075: Open App Hub from the Start menu.
Search for the application and choose Install; free applications install at once.
Applications marked Licence required open a request form instead; see Request licensed software.
Keep the laptop awake and online until the status shows Installed.
If an installation stays at Pending for more than 30 minutes, restart and choose Retry.

question: Printing gives operation could not be completed, error 0x00000709. This is the second time this month. Device: Dell Latitude 7450. I already restarted twice.
reference_answer: Removed the stale queue, disabled Windows default printer management and re-added FollowMe from App Hub.

KB-1066: Open Settings, Bluetooth and devices, Printers and scanners.
Turn off Let Windows manage my default printer.
Open App Hub and run Add office printers.
Back in Printers and scanners, select the FollowMe queue and choose Set as default.

question: The screen in the large meeting room in London is blank and we have a client call in 15 minutes. My laptop is a Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 (Windows 11). I tried the steps on the intranet but no luck.
reference_answer: Display input was set to HDMI 2. Switched to Room PC and the console woke.

KB-1049: In a new Outlook meeting choose Room Finder and pick a room in your building.
Add a Teams link if anyone joins remotely; room screens join with one touch.
At the start, tap Check in on the panel outside the room (RoomBoard London and RoomBoard Munich).
To present, tap Share on the table console, or join the meeting from your laptop and share there.
If the screen is blank, check the console is awake and the input is set to Room PC.
For a broken screen, camera or panel, raise a ticket with the room name. Support hours are 07:00 to 19:00 UK time, Monday to Friday.

question: I need a Visio licence for process mapping. Who approves it? I have a customer call in an hour and need this fixed.
reference_answer: Licence had been reclaimed after 60 days without use. User re-requested; manager approved. Followed KB-1077.

KB-1077: Look up the application in the software catalogue to see its annual charge and approval rule.
In HelpHub choose Request software, pick the application and give the business reason.
Charges under USD 300 a year need your manager's approval.
Charges of USD 300 a year or more need your manager and your cost-centre owner.
Applications that handle Restricted data also need the data owner.
After the last approval the application appears in App Hub within 60 minutes.
A licence not used for 60 days is reclaimed; you are warned by email 7 days before.

question: Hello IT, I get access denied when opening the budgets folder on the shared drive. It began yesterday afternoon.
reference_answer: User was not in the folder group. Raised a shared folder request; owner approved and access worked after sign-out and sign-in. Followed KB-1011.

KB-1011: Ask a colleague for the exact folder path, for example \\files.larkhaven.example\finance\budgets.
In HelpHub choose Request access, then Shared folder, and paste the path.
Choose Read or Read and write.
The folder owner receives the request and approves or declines it.
After approval, sign out of your laptop and sign in again so the new permission applies.

question: Do we still have to change passwords every 90 days? My colleague says no. It worked fine last week. I am using a MacBook Pro 14 (M3).
reference_answer: Passwords no longer expire on a schedule; you must change yours only if it may have been exposed.

KB-1003: Passwords no longer expire on a schedule; you must change yours only if it may have been exposed.

question: hello it, strange pop-ups keep appearing and my files have odd names.
reference_answer: Device isolated and re-imaged. Files restored from OneDrive.

KB-1086: Disconnect from the network: turn off Wi-Fi and unplug the network cable and dock.
Leave the laptop switched on; switching it off destroys evidence.
Call the service desk from a phone; do not use the affected laptop to raise the ticket.
Do not pay, click or type anything that the laptop demands.
Security Operations isolates the laptop and tells you when it is safe to use.

question: A colleague is leaving, what do we do? It started this morning. My laptop is a MacBook Air 13 (M3) (macOS).
reference_answer: Clarified the request with the user by phone. Account had reached its end date. Sponsor renewed for a further 6 months; account re-enabled. Followed KB-1093.

KB-1093: The sponsoring manager chooses New contractor in HelpHub and gives the company, start date and end date.
The end date can be at most 6 months ahead; the sponsor is asked to renew 14 days before it.
Contractors get email, Teams and the applications the sponsor requests; remote access is a separate request.
Contractors use a Larkhaven laptop unless their company's device has passed a security review.
The account is disabled automatically on the end date.

question: PIN and fingerprint both stopped working after I changed my password. It is not urgent but it is annoying.
reference_answer: Signed in with password, removed and recreated the Windows Hello PIN. Fingerprint re-enrolled. Followed KB-1013.

KB-1013: On the sign-in screen choose Sign-in options and sign in with your LarkID password instead.
Open Settings, Accounts, Sign-in options, PIN (Windows Hello) and choose Remove.
Restart the laptop while connected to the office network or SecureTunnel.
Return to Sign-in options, choose Set up under PIN and approve the LarkID prompt.
Add fingerprint or face recognition again if you use them.

question: How do I check the status of my request? Laptop asset tag LH-L-00186. Please help.
reference_answer: Ticket was waiting for the user's reply to a question. User answered; work resumed. Followed KB-1098.

KB-1098: Say what you were trying to do, what happened instead and the exact error message or code.
Say when it started and whether it worked before.
Say whether colleagues are affected; that sets the priority.
Add a screenshot of the error, not a photo of the whole desk.
Never put a password in a ticket.

question: Hi there, I get an error when I open the app. It worked fine last week. Restarting did not help
reference_answer: Clarified the request with the user by phone. Application is available in App Hub. User installed it without admin rights. Followed KB-1076.

KB-1076: Open App Hub from Launchpad or the Applications folder.
Search for the application and choose Install; free applications install at once.
Applications marked Licence required open a request form instead; see Request licensed software.
Enter your Mac password only if App Hub itself asks for it; never for an installer downloaded from the web.
If an installation stays at Pending for more than 30 minutes, restart and choose Retry.

question: Please increase my mailbox size, I am at the limit. It started after the latest update. Please help.
reference_answer: Explained that quota is fixed at 50 GB. Emptied Deleted Items and enabled the 12-month archive policy; usage dropped to 31 GB. Followed KB-1039.

KB-1039: In Outlook open File, Tools, Mailbox Cleanup to see which folders are largest.
Sort the largest folder by size and delete or save big attachments to OneDrive.
Empty Deleted Items and Junk Email.
Mail older than 24 months moves to your Online Archive automatically; check it has not been turned off.
If you are still above 45 GB, raise a ticket to have the archive start at 12 months.

question: Hello IT, SecureTunnel refuses to connect with ST-407. It says endpoint protection. My laptop is a Dell Latitude 5440 (Windows 11). It is not urgent but it is annoying. Regards, Ahmed
reference_answer: EndpointShield definitions were 12 days old. Forced an update and restarted; device check passed.

KB-1021: Read the failed check named under the error message.
For Encryption, confirm BitLocker or FileVault is on and wait for encryption to finish.
For Endpoint protection, open EndpointShield and choose Update now, then restart.
For Updates, install all pending operating system updates and restart.
Connect again; the check runs each time you connect.

question: My laptop will not switch on this morning. No lights at all. It worked fine last week. Laptop asset tag LH-L-00148.
reference_answer: No power after reset. Issued a loan laptop and sent the device for repair. Followed KB-1056.

KB-1056: Connect the original charger directly to a wall socket, not through a dock, and wait 15 minutes.
Try a different socket and, if you can, a colleague's charger of the same type.
Hold the power button for 30 seconds, release it, then press it once.
Disconnect docks, USB devices and external screens, then try again.
If there is still no sign of power, raise a ticket or visit a Tech Bar; a loan laptop is issued while yours is repaired.

question: Hi team, A member of my team leaves on Friday. What do I need to do about their laptop and account? This has been happening since Monday. Device: Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 5. I have not tried anything yet. I cannot do any work until this is sorted.
reference_answer: Leaver request raised by the manager. Account scheduled to disable at 18:00 on the last day; return box sent.

KB-1092: Your manager raises the leaver request in HelpHub as soon as the leaving date is agreed.
Move work files that colleagues need from your OneDrive to the team's shared folder before your last day.
Remove personal files from the laptop; IT does not recover them afterwards.
Unenrol your personal phone in DeviceCare on your last day.
Return laptop, charger, dock, phone and badge at a Tech Bar, or use the prepaid box sent to home workers.
Your mailbox is kept for 90 days and your manager can ask for access to it.

question: My laptop is very slow, what is wrong? It takes minutes to open Outlook. I have a customer call in an hour and need this fixed.
reference_answer: Disk was 97 percent full. Cleared 60 GB with Storage settings; laptop responsive again. Followed KB-1055.

KB-1055: Restart the Mac from the Apple menu.
Open System Settings, General, Software Update, install what is offered and restart again.
Open Activity Monitor and sort by Memory and by CPU. Quit what you do not need.
Open System Settings, General, Login Items, and remove apps you do not use daily.
Open System Settings, General, Storage, and free space until at least 15 percent of the disk is free.
If Memory Pressure in Activity Monitor stays red with only your normal apps open, raise a ticket; include the laptop asset tag.

question: Teams will not sign in, it shows error code caa70004. The web version is fine. It started this morning. Regards, Rohan
reference_answer: Reset the Teams app from Installed apps and signed in again with LarkID. Working.

KB-1042: Check that Teams works at https://teams.microsoft.com in a browser.
Right-click the Teams icon in the system tray and choose Quit.
Open Settings, Apps, Installed apps, Microsoft Teams, Advanced options, and choose Reset.
Check the date, time and time zone are set automatically.
Start Teams and sign in with LarkID.

question: I get a low disk space warning every day and cannot install updates. This is the second time this month.
reference_answer: OneDrive was keeping 80 GB locally. Used Free up space and enabled Storage Sense; 45 percent free. Followed KB-1071.

KB-1071: Open Settings, System, Storage, to see what is using space.
Turn on Storage Sense and choose Run Storage Sense now.
Right-click the OneDrive folder in File Explorer and choose Free up space.
Empty the Recycle Bin and the Downloads folder.
Uninstall applications you no longer use from Settings, Apps.

question: My laptop will not join LarkNet in the London office. It asks for a user name. Restarting did not help. Thank you, Mateo
reference_answer: Network certificate was missing after a rebuild. Ran Repair network certificate from App Hub over cable; LarkNet connected. Followed KB-1025.

KB-1025: Select the network icon in the taskbar and choose LarkNet.
If Windows asks for a user name and password, cancel; the certificate is missing.
Connect a network cable or use the LarkGuest network with VPN, then open App Hub and run Repair network certificate.
Restart and select LarkNet again; it connects without prompting.

question:
Hello IT,

My assistant needs to manage my calendar and send invitations for me. Laptop asset tag LH-L-00256. I already restarted twice. I have a customer call in an hour and need this fixed.

Thank you, Mateo
reference_answer: Showed the user how to grant delegate access from Sharing Permissions. Delegate confirmed they can create meetings. Followed KB-1040.

KB-1040: In Outlook open Calendar, right-click your calendar and choose Sharing Permissions.
Add the person and choose Can view all details, or Can edit.
For someone who sends invitations for you, choose Delegate and decide whether they see private items.
The other person accepts the sharing invitation that arrives by email.
Remove a person from the same screen when they no longer need access.

question: On VPN from home on my Dell Latitude 5440, the intranet and HlepHub just spin. This is the second time this month
reference_answer: Browser secure DNS was bypassing the VPN resolver. Disabled it and internal sites resolved. Followed KB-1019.

KB-1019: Open Command Prompt and run: ipconfig /flushdns
Open Settings, Network and internet, your adapter, and set DNS server assignment to Automatic.
In the browser settings turn off Use secure DNS.

question: Am I allowed to send a customer contract to an outside lawyer by email?
reference_answer: Confidential: contracts, pricing, personal data. Share only with people who need it; outside the company only by SendSafe.

KB-1088: Confidential: contracts, pricing, personal data. Share only with people who need it; outside the company only by SendSafe.

question:
Good morning,

VaultKey extension is installed but it does not fill in passwords on any site. I tried the steps on the intranet but no luck.
reference_answer: Extension was not signed in. Signed in with LarkID and enabled autofill. Created a shared vault for the team account. Followed KB-1015.

KB-1015: Install VaultKey from App Hub on your laptop.
Open it and choose Sign in with LarkID; there is no separate master password.
Add the browser extension when prompted and pin it to the toolbar.
Import passwords saved in the browser, then turn off the browser's own password saving.
Share team passwords through a VaultKey shared vault, never by email or chat.

question:
Good morning,

I need a loan laptop for a trip in two weeks. I cannot do any work until this is sorted.
reference_answer: Destination is on the high-risk list. Travel request raised; loan laptop and phone prepared for collection.

KB-1089: Check the high-risk country list on the intranet travel page.
For a listed country, raise a HelpHub travel request at least 5 business days before departure.
IT issues a clean loan laptop and phone; your own devices stay at home.
Use only SecureTunnel on hotel, airport and conference Wi-Fi.
Keep devices with you; do not leave them in hotel rooms or checked baggage.
Return loan devices within 2 business days of coming back; they are wiped.

question:
I need a laptop with more memory for data work. My manager supports this.

Thanks, Valentina
reference_answer: Laptop was 52 months old. Replacement request raised without approval; new laptop shipped. Followed KB-1057.

KB-1057: Check the age of your laptop at https://id.larkhaven.example/devices under My devices.
If it is 48 months or older, choose Request replacement in HelpHub; no approval is needed.
If it is younger, raise a ticket describing the problem; IT confirms whether repair or replacement is right.
Roles that need more than the standard specification need the manager's approval and a cost centre.
Back up nothing by hand: files in OneDrive and settings are restored on the new laptop.
Return the old laptop within 5 business days of receiving the new one.

question: Hi team, I received an email asking me to confirm my password for a mailbox upgrade. It looks odd. I already restarted twice. Regards, Jonas
reference_answer: Email confirmed as phishing and removed from 42 mailboxes. User had not clicked. Followed KB-1085.

KB-1085: Do not click links, open attachments or reply.
Select the message and choose Report phishing in the Outlook toolbar; the message moves out of your inbox.
If you already clicked a link or opened an attachment, call the service desk now; this is handled as priority 2.
If you typed your password on the page, change it at https://id.larkhaven.example/reset before doing anything else.
Security Operations replies within 1 hour to say whether the email was malicious.

question: There was a problem connecting to OneDrive, error code 0x8004de40. It worked fine last week. I have a customer call in an hour and need this fixed
reference_answer: Reset the OneDrive client and signed in again; all files re-checked and in sync.

KB-1047: Click the OneDrive cloud icon in the menu bar and read the message it shows.
Choose Pause syncing, wait a minute and choose Resume syncing.
Rename files the sync client lists as not allowed.
Free up disk space until at least 1 GB is available.
Quit OneDrive and reopen it from Applications; sign in with LarkID if asked.

question:
Hi there,

SecureTunnel shows reconnecting again and again since this morning. Restarting did not help.
reference_answer: Regional VPN gateway incident was in progress. Linked the ticket to the incident; resolved when the gateway recovered. Followed KB-1022.

KB-1022: Check the service status page in HelpHub for a VPN incident in your region.
Move closer to the router or use a network cable, then test again.
Open Device Manager, Network adapters, your Wi-Fi adapter, Power Management, and clear Allow the computer to turn off this device.
Update SecureTunnel from App Hub to version 5.3 or later.
If drops continue on a wired connection, raise a ticket with the times of three recent drops.

question: Hi, Lost my laptop at the airport. It was switched off. Restarting did not help.
reference_answer: Phone located by the user the next day. Work profile had been removed remotely; re-enrolled after inspection. Followed KB-1062.

KB-1062: Call the service desk straight away; lost devices are handled 24 hours a day as priority 2.
Say when and where you last had the device and whether it was switched on and unlocked.
IT locks the device remotely. Wiping a device needs the approval of the IT duty manager.
Change your LarkID password at https://id.larkhaven.example/reset.
For theft, report it to the police and add the report number to the ticket within 5 business days.
If the device is found, do not use it; return it to IT for checking.

question: the expenses site shows a blank page in chrome but my colleague can open it.
reference_answer: Cleared cached files and cookies; the site loaded. Followed KB-1081.

KB-1081: Open the site in a private or InPrivate window. If it works there, continue below.
Press Ctrl + Shift + Delete (Cmd + Shift + Delete on a Mac), choose Cached images and files and Cookies for the last 7 days, and clear.
Turn off extensions one at a time to find the one that breaks the page.
Try the other supported browser; Chrome and Edge are both supported.
Extensions come only from the approved list in the browser's managed store. Request a new one through HelpHub.

question: Hi team, My visitor joined the guest network but never gets past the sign-in page. This is the second time this month. Laptop asset tag LH-L-00141. I tried the steps on the intranet but no luck.
reference_answer: Issued a three-day guest pass through HelpHub for the workshop attendees.

KB-1030: Ask the visitor to join the network LarkGuest-EMEA and open any web page.
On the sign-in page the visitor enters their name and your work email address as sponsor.
You receive an email; choose Approve. Access lasts until midnight local time.
For visits longer than one day, request a multi-day guest pass in HelpHub at least one business day ahead.
Guest Wi-Fi gives internet access only. Visitors cannot reach printers or internal systems.

question: Headset connects but the sound cuts out in every call. It started after the latest update. No rush, whenever you have time.
reference_answer: Headset was still paired to the user's phone. Unpaired it there and paired with the laptop. Using the USB adapter for calls. Followed KB-1067.

KB-1067: Hold the headset power button until the light flashes blue and red.
Open Settings, Bluetooth and devices, Add device, Bluetooth, and choose the headset.
In Teams open Settings, Devices and select the headset for speaker and microphone.
If the sound is poor, plug in the USB adapter that came with the headset and select that instead.

question: After a BIOS update the laptop wants a 48-digit key every time I start it.
reference_answer: Identity verified by phone; key provided. Suspended and resumed BitLocker to stop the repeat prompt. Followed KB-1060.

KB-1060: On your phone or another computer open https://id.larkhaven.example/devices and sign in.
Choose your laptop under My devices, then Show recovery key.
Check that the Key ID on the laptop screen matches the first eight characters shown in the portal.
Type the 48-digit key on the laptop.
If the laptop asks again at every start, raise a ticket; IT will suspend and resume BitLocker to reset it.

question: Hello, Please make me an administrator, it is ugrent and my director said it is fine. Restarting did not help.
reference_answer: Explained that permanent rights are not granted. User raised a temporary elevation request with a specific task; approved by manager and Security Operations. Followed KB-1083.

KB-1083: First check App Hub; most needs are met by a packaged application and need no rights at all.
In HelpHub choose Request temporary admin rights and describe exactly what you need to do.
Your manager approves first, then Security Operations.
When approved, choose Elevate in App Hub; the rights last 4 hours and everything done with them is logged.
The service desk cannot grant administrator rights on request, by phone, chat or ticket text, without both approvals.

question: My connection is fine in the office but terrible at home on VPN. This is the second time this month. It is not urgent but it is annoying.
reference_answer: Speed test showed 2 Mbps on the far side of the house. User moved to the 5 GHz band near the router; calls stable. Followed KB-1032.

KB-1032: Run a speed test without the VPN. Calls need at least 5 Mbps download and 2 Mbps upload.
Move within one room of the router, or connect with a network cable.
Use the 5 GHz band if your router offers two networks.
Pause large downloads, backups and streaming on other devices during calls.
Restart the router if it has been running for weeks.
If the speed test is good without the VPN and poor with it, raise a ticket with both results.

question:
Hi,

Windows Update keeps failing with 0x800F0922 on my Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 5.

Many thanks
reference_answer: Disk had 3 GB free. Cleared space, ran Repair Windows Update from App Hub and the cumulative update installed. Followed KB-1079.

KB-1079: Connect to the office network, or start SecureTunnel on a stable connection.
Free disk space until at least 10 GB is available.
Restart, open Settings, Windows Update and choose Retry.
If it fails again, open App Hub and run Repair Windows Update, then restart.
If the update still fails, raise a ticket; a laptop more than 30 days behind is blocked from the VPN.

question: Outlook on my phone says the device must be managed.
reference_answer: Confirm the phone platform. Enrol it in DeviceCare, install the applicable managed Outlook app, and sign in with LarkID.

KB-1034: Install DeviceCare from the App Store and sign in with LarkID to enrol the phone.
Accept the management profile in Settings, General, VPN and Device Management.
Install Outlook from the App Store.
Open Outlook, add your work address and sign in with LarkID.
Set a 6-digit passcode if the phone asks; shorter passcodes are not accepted.
KB-1035: Install DeviceCare from Google Play and sign in with LarkID to create the work profile.
Open the work profile's Play Store, marked with a briefcase, and install Outlook.
Open the work copy of Outlook, add your work address and sign in with LarkID.
Set a 6-digit screen lock if the phone asks; patterns are not accepted.

question:
Hello,

My laptop will not join LarkNet in the Chicago office. It asks for a user name. It began yesterday afternoon. I have not tried anything yet.
reference_answer: Network certificate was missing after a rebuild. Ran Repair network certificate from App Hub over cable; LarkNet connected.

KB-1026: Click the Wi-Fi icon in the menu bar and choose LarkNet.
If macOS asks for a user name and password, cancel; the certificate is missing.
Connect a network cable or use the LarkGuest network with VPN, then open App Hub and run Repair network certificate.
Restart and choose LarkNet again; approve the certificate prompt once with your Mac password.

question: Hello, Headset conencts but the sound cuts out in every call. I already restarted twice.
reference_answer: Headset was still paired to the user's phone. Unpaired it there and paired with the laptop. Using the USB adapter for calls.

KB-1068: Hold the headset power button until the light flashes blue and red.
Open System Settings, Bluetooth, and choose Connect next to the headset.
In Teams open Settings, Devices and select the headset for speaker and microphone.
If the sound is poor, plug in the USB adapter that came with the headset and select that instead.

question: We need a new shared mailbox for the events team with five members. I already restarted twice. I have a customer call in an hour and need this fixed. Thanks, Sakura
reference_answer: Owner approved the membership request. Mailbox appeared in Outlook after a restart.

KB-1012: For access to an existing mailbox, choose Request access, then Shared mailbox, in HelpHub and enter its address.
The mailbox owner approves the request; the mailbox then appears in Outlook automatically within 60 minutes.
For a new mailbox, choose New shared mailbox and give the address you want, the owner and the first members.
Addresses must describe a function, for example invoices-emea@larkhaven.example, not a person.

question: Hello IT, My MacBook Pro 14 (M4) restarts by itself and says it restarted because of a problem. It started after the latest update. Thank you, Diego
reference_answer: Crashes stopped with the third-party hub disconnected. Supplied a supported dock. Followed KB-1070.

KB-1070: Choose Report when the message appears so the details are saved.
Disconnect every accessory and use the Mac on its own for a day.
Open System Settings, General, Software Update and install what is offered.
Update SecureTunnel and EndpointShield from App Hub.
If it happens again within a week, raise a ticket and say whether accessories were connected.

question: My signature shows my old job title. Can you fix it?
reference_answer: Job title comes from PeopleHub. Directed the user to HR to correct the record; signature regenerated afterwards. Followed KB-1051.

KB-1051: In Outlook choose File, Automatic Replies, and set the dates of your absence.
Write one reply for colleagues and one for people outside the company; do not include personal phone numbers.
For the signature, open https://intranet.larkhaven.example/signature and choose Copy signature.
In Outlook open Settings, Signatures, paste it and set it for new messages.
If your title or office is wrong in the signature, ask HR to correct your PeopleHub record; IT cannot edit it.

question: Hello IT, Getting a certificate warning on HelpHub since this morning. I already restarted twice. My whole team has the same problem. Regards, Chen
reference_answer: Company root certificate was missing. Ran Repair network certificate from App Hub; warning gone after browser restart. Followed KB-1033.

KB-1033: Check that the address ends in larkhaven.example. If it does not, close the page and report it as phishing.
Check the laptop date and time are correct.
Open App Hub and run Repair network certificate, then restart the browser.
Do not choose Proceed anyway on a page that asks for your password.
If the warning remains on a company laptop, raise a ticket with the full address.

question: Messages are stuck and will not send.
reference_answer: Clarified the request with the user by phone. User was not a member of the list. Owner added them at id.larkhaven.example/groups. Followed KB-1052.

KB-1052: To join or leave a list, ask its owner. The owner is shown on the list's contact card in Outlook.
Owners add and remove members at https://id.larkhaven.example/groups.
For a new list, raise a HelpHub request with the name, two owners and the purpose.
List addresses start with dl-, for example dl-sales-emea@larkhaven.example.
Lists with no owner for 30 days are disabled.

question: Hi, I installed the VPN but it asks to allow a system extension and I do not know where. My laptop is a Dell Latitude 7450 (Windows 11). I tried the steps on the intranet but no luck. My whole team has the same problem.
reference_answer: Guided installation from App Hub and first sign-in with LarkID. Connection confirmed by opening the intranet.

KB-1016: Open App Hub from the Start menu and install SecureTunnel.
Start SecureTunnel from the system tray; the gateway vpn.larkhaven.example is filled in already.
Choose Connect and sign in with your LarkID email and password.
Approve the prompt in LarkID Authenticator.
Wait for the device check to finish; the tray icon turns green when you are connected.
Open https://intranet.larkhaven.example to confirm internal sites load.

question: Hello IT, I cannot find any printer on my new laptop in the Bengaluru office. I already restarted twice.
reference_answer: Queue was not installed. Ran Add office printers from App Hub; test page released by badge. Followed KB-1065.

KB-1065: Open App Hub and run Add office printers; the queue FollowMe-APAC is installed.
Print to FollowMe-APAC from any application.
At any printer, tap your badge on the reader and choose Print all or select jobs.
Jobs not released within 24 hours are deleted.
To scan, tap your badge, choose Scan to my email, and the scan arrives as a PDF.
For paper jams or toner, use the QR code on the printer; for anything else raise a ticket. Support hours are 07:00 to 19:00 India Standard Time, Monday to Friday.

question: Hello, What time does the IT service desk open in London? Please help.
reference_answer: The Europe, Middle East and Africa service desk is open 07:00 to 19:00 UK time, Monday to Friday; priority 1 and lost devices are handled 24 hours a day.

KB-1096: The Europe, Middle East and Africa service desk is open 07:00 to 19:00 UK time, Monday to Friday; priority 1 and lost devices are handled 24 hours a day.

question: Please help me register LarkID Authenticator. I do not get the approval notification.
reference_answer: Confirm the phone platform. Register the authenticator from the LarkID security page and check the platform-specific notification settings before approving the test prompt.

KB-1004: Install LarkID Authenticator from the App Store.
On your laptop, open https://id.larkhaven.example/security and choose Add method, then Authenticator app.
In the app, tap Add account and scan the QR code shown on the laptop.
Allow notifications when iOS asks; approvals arrive as notifications.
Approve the test prompt and type the two-digit number to finish.
KB-1005: Install LarkID Authenticator from Google Play, or from the work profile store on an enrolled phone.
On your laptop, open https://id.larkhaven.example/security and choose Add method, then Authenticator app.
In the app, tap Add account and scan the QR code shown on the laptop.
Turn off battery optimisation for the app so approval prompts are not delayed.
Approve the test prompt and type the two-digit number to finish.

question: when i share my screen on my macbook air 13 (m2) everyone sees black. it started this morning.
reference_answer: Screen recording permission for Teams was off after the macOS update. Enabled it and restarted Teams. Followed KB-1045.

KB-1045: Open System Settings, Privacy and Security, Screen and System Audio Recording.
Turn on Microsoft Teams, and your browser if you join meetings in the browser.
Choose Quit and Reopen when macOS offers it.
Start a test meeting and share a single window first.

question: I changed my password on my phone and now my MacBook Air 13 (M3) will not let me in at start-up. I already restarted twice. Please help.
reference_answer: Previous password unlocked the disk. Synchronised the Mac password with LarkID over SecureTunnel.

KB-1061: Try the previous password; the start-up screen may still expect it.
On your phone open https://id.larkhaven.example/devices, choose the Mac and Show recovery key.
On the Mac click the question mark, choose Restart and show password reset options, and enter the recovery key.
Set the Mac password to match your current LarkID password.
After signing in, connect to the office network or SecureTunnel so the passwords stay in step.

question: DeviceCare says my iPhone phone is not compliant and email stopped working. This is the second time this month. No rush, whenever you have time. Regards, Johanna
reference_answer: Check that iOS is supported and DeviceCare is enrolled. Set a six-digit passcode if prompted and wait for the compliance confirmation before opening work email.

KB-1073: Check the phone runs one of the two latest major iOS versions.
Install DeviceCare from the App Store and sign in with LarkID.
Follow the prompts to install the management profile, then return to DeviceCare.
Wait for the green Compliant tick, then install Outlook and Teams.

question:
Teams is not working properly. I have a customer call in an hour and need this fixed.

Thanks
reference_answer: Clarified the request with the user by phone. Room console was frozen. Restarted it remotely; one-touch join working. Followed KB-1048.

KB-1048: In a new Outlook meeting choose Room Finder and pick a room in your building.
Add a Teams link if anyone joins remotely; room screens join with one touch.
At the start, tap Check in on the panel outside the room (RoomBoard Chicago and RoomBoard Toronto).
To present, tap Share on the table console, or join the meeting from your laptop and share there.
If the screen is blank, check the console is awake and the input is set to Room PC.
For a broken screen, camera or panel, raise a ticket with the room name. Support hours are 07:00 to 19:00 Central Time, Monday to Friday.

question: I am new and need to set up the authenticator app on my Android phone. The QR code will not scan. This has been happening since Monday.
reference_answer: Install LarkID Authenticator for Android, then add the app as a method from the LarkID security page on the laptop and scan its QR code. Use HelpHub MFA support if registration fails.

KB-1005: Install LarkID Authenticator from Google Play, or from the work profile store on an enrolled phone.
On your laptop, open https://id.larkhaven.example/security and choose Add method, then Authenticator app.
In the app, tap Add account and scan the QR code shown on the laptop.
Turn off battery optimisation for the app so approval prompts are not delayed.
Approve the test prompt and type the two-digit number to finish.

question: Hi team, SecureTunnel shows reconnecting again and again since this morning.
reference_answer: Regional VPN gateway incident was in progress. Linked the ticket to the incident; resolved when the gateway recovered. Followed KB-1023.

KB-1023: Check the service status page in HelpHub for a VPN incident in your region.
Move closer to the router or use a network cable, then test again.
Open System Settings, Wi-Fi, Details for your network, and turn off Limit IP address tracking.
Update SecureTunnel from App Hub to version 5.3 or later; version 5.2 drops on macOS 26.
If drops continue on a wired connection, raise a ticket with the times of three recent drops.

question: Enrolment fails at the profile step on my new phone. It started this morning. Restarting did not help. My whole team has the same problem.
reference_answer: Ask whether the phone is an iPhone or Android. Check that its OS version is supported, then use the applicable DeviceCare setup and profile steps.

KB-1073: Check the phone runs one of the two latest major iOS versions.
Install DeviceCare from the App Store and sign in with LarkID.
Follow the prompts to install the management profile, then return to DeviceCare.
Wait for the green Compliant tick, then install Outlook and Teams.
KB-1074: Check the phone runs one of the two latest major Android versions and is not rooted.
Install DeviceCare from Google Play and sign in with LarkID.
Accept the creation of a work profile; work apps appear with a briefcase badge.
Set a 6-digit screen lock when asked.
Wait for the green Compliant tick, then install Outlook and Teams from the work Play Store.

question: My macro workbook was quarantined and I need it back for month-end. Device: MacBook Air 13 (M3).
reference_answer: File reviewed by Security Operations and confirmed safe. Released from quarantine and excluded by hash. Followed KB-1084.

KB-1084: Do not try to restore the file yourself.
Note the file name and where it came from: an email, a website or a USB stick.
If it came from an email, report that email with the Report phishing button.
If you believe the file is legitimate work material, raise a ticket for Security Operations with the file name and the alert time.
If alerts repeat or the laptop behaves strangely, follow the article What to do if you suspect malware.
